about_short_description.short_description: Clearco is an online financial platform that provides growth capital to e-commerce and B2B companies.

product.name: Clearco Ecommerce Funding
product.description: Non-dilutive growth capital for U.S.-based direct-to-consumer ecommerce and SaaS businesses, supporting inventory, marketing, supplier payments, product launches, and expansion.

product.name: Rolling Funding Capacity
product.description: A replenishing funding facility that restores available capital as payments are made, supporting recurring expenses such as advertising, supplier payments, and ongoing reinvestment.

product.name: Fixed Funding Capacity
product.description: A one-time funding amount with an estimated payment schedule, designed for planned initiatives such as major marketing campaigns, inventory purchases, seasonal demand, and market expansion.

product.name: Invoice Funding
product.description: Working capital used to pay supplier invoices and eligible business receipts directly, helping ecommerce companies purchase inventory, fund production, and preserve cash reserves.

product.name: Cash Advance
product.description: Capital deposited directly into a business bank account for flexible use across marketing, inventory, payroll, operations, and other growth-related expenses.

product.name: Clearco Funding Advisory and Support
product.description: Consultative support that helps ecommerce businesses evaluate funding structures, deployment methods, payment options, and capital strategies for growth.
